**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (clean review; two non-blocking notes below).

## What looks good
- One law with the program sim: `chain_of` asks `carry::entry` at every boundary (rest/across.rs), a Clip ends the chain (own fresh block, the side that never assumes material gone), a refusal returns `REST_CARRY_REFUSAL` plus the carry's own reason.
- The carried rest grid can only over-state material. Upright carries keep the swept tops exactly. A flip reads `top = tz - floor`, so setup 1's cuts are not credited at all after a flip (more material than reality, never less). A column cut through reads its standing top (stated in the decision note).
- Rapid acquittal (`acquit_by_prior`) acquits only a dive that ends above the carried top. A disc wholly off the grid leaves the conviction standing, so the #319 deferral does not clear a rapid through real carried material.
- Stamp: crossing chains add a term for the setups crossed, each turn (Debug round-trip exact) and the origin setup's stock on top of the predecessors' path digest. A non-crossing chain returns the old `digest_of` unchanged, so single-setup stamps are byte-identical (golden_cl, stock_stamp, operations green). A refused chain digests its refusal text.
- Refused carry is refused at `collect_job` for every `reads_prior` op, by name (operation/job.rs:211-218). No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in src. `rest.rs` 362 lines, new modules carry provenance lines, `pilots.rs` split is a pure move.
- Simulation path unchanged: `simulate_document` / `carry::entry` are not touched (only `first_body` visibility), so a non-quarter turn with no `reads_prior` op is still refused there. No silent fallback was added.

| clippy `-D warnings`, app + sim, all targets | clean |

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Setup 2's declared stock larger than the carried setup-1 block: the carried grid is the setup-1 block, so a Pocket3D/MultiAxisRough mask drops columns off that grid (`dex.above(z)` has nothing there) and the rest pass will not cut material that setup 2's own stock declares there. This matches the program sim (the carried body replaces setup 2's block), it leaves material rather than gouging, and `prior_surface` treats a partially-off-grid dive disc by its on-grid cells only. The decision note defers it to #319. Please make sure #319 covers a test with a taller/wider setup-2 stock.
2. `setup_carry::a_turn_the_lattice_cannot_carry_is_refused_by_name` no longer reaches `simulate_document` (Face2 is refused at generation first), so nothing in app now pins the sim-side refusal for a non-`reads_prior` (posed) op; sim's `stock_carry.rs` covers the lattice only. Consider a small test with a posed op. Also `rest_across_setups` has no flip (X/Y 180) case for the floor/top roles; the code reads conservatively but is unpinned.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
